issue.title: SASE editable reinstall drops core Justfile overrides and can downgrade the local wheel
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-df.2.1.4.2 note #3: local sase_core_rs 0.43.0 built from f4bf6074 was downgraded to published 0.42.7 by editable reinstall. At SASE ac23f63ee4, Justfile _install-venv forwards venv_dir/sase_core_dir to rust-install but runs bare nested just _core-overrides-arg for uv pip install -e. Landing reproduced the helper mismatch without building: with an opened valid core checkout passed via --set sase_core_dir and a scratch venv, the helper emits --overrides; the nested default invocation returns an empty string because the default core path is absent. Thus outer Justfile settings can be lost before resolving the exact pyproject pin. The phase called this a bare-name override issue; confirm whether any additional failure occurs when the override is actually emitted, rather than assuming that diagnosis. Preserve normal published-pin resolution when no local core/wheel is requested. Forward the effective settings or bind the actual local wheel through editable resolution, and regression-test both source and SASE_CORE_WHEEL paths. No fresh full install or downgrade was performed during landing; phase observation plus independent helper reproduction are the evidence. Same-type/all-type searches, last-week task sweep and active host epics found no duplicate or causal owner.

task_type_fields.impact: Feature verification can silently run against a stale published Rust binding after successfully building the intended local source; the phase had to reinstall its cached wheel.
task_type_fields.repro: In a clean external SASE checkout at ac23f63ee4, open gh:sase-org/sase-core with sase repo. Compare just --set venv_dir <scratch> --set sase_core_dir <opened-core> _core-overrides-arg with the bare just _core-overrides-arg used inside editable reinstall: the former emits an override file, the latter emits nothing. Phase df.2.1.4.2 observed the resulting 0.43.0 to 0.42.7 downgrade during just install-venv.

issue.creation_reason: Repair phase bob-cli-df.2.1.4.2 note #3 reported that install-venv replaced its freshly built core wheel with the published pin. Landing independently confirmed that the nested override helper loses outer Justfile settings, so this setup defect needs a separate bounded fix.

payload.entry: B4 outer-land source corroboration for proposing bead df.2.1.4.2 #3: SASE 9a38ff35b1 Justfile still forwards explicit venv_dir/sase_core_dir to rust-install but calls bare nested just _core-overrides-arg at editable reinstall. No fresh install/downgrade experiment claimed. Remaining B4 repair should pass SASE_CORE_DIR as an inherited environment variable and verify the isolated wheel, leaving installer remediation here.
